text:
Aisha: Morning folks — quick async standup from me.
What I did: merged tokenizer patch for Spanish edge cases; ran evals for synthia-v3-smallq (1k samples).
Blockers: spotted a promptset regression — golden prompt hallucination +2.2% vs baseline; KV warmup on dedicated nodes is slow, delaying canary.
Today: need someone to eyeball top-20 failing prompts; @Rob can you review the CR for max_seq change? @Priya can infra prewarm KV pools?

Rob: On it. I'll review the CR now. Early glance looks fine but watch mem footprint.
Also noticed reranker precision dip in eval logs (rnk@5 -1.1%). I'll spin a small repro eval job.

Priya: Prewarm scheduled, setting prewarm=true for the canary. Infra tip: if you run on Dedicated + tinyq, add this snippet to the deploy config:
```
deploy:
  prewarm: true
  prewarm_batches: 200
  model_quant: tinyq
```
I bumped prewarm_batches to 200 for initial warmup and pinged SRE.

infra-bot: Canary deploy started for synthia-v3-smallq-canary on rack-3; 3/3 nodes up. (logs: deploy/1738861122/canary)
(reacts :rocket:)

Marco: Quick context on gates — target was <=1.0% absolute hallucination delta on golden prompts. 2.2% exceeds that, so add to regression list.
I can triage top-20 later today but need the failure CSV.

Lina: Exported top failures to S3: s3://redwood-qa/synthia-v3/samples/failures-173886.csv
Also flagged cases where reranker disagrees with generator.

Aisha: Thanks. @Marco please call out any prompt engineering changes you'd like; @Rob if reranker repros the drop, consider pinning the previous reranker as a fallback for the canary.
I'll open an issue with golden-prompt diffs and link the CSV. Note: if you touch promptsets, update testvectors/README with a short note.

Rob: Will push a repro job and post the job link here when ready.

Priya: Prewarm done. Monitoring KV cache hit rate now.
infra-bot: KV warmup finished (avg kv latency 28ms).
